title: Trump’s Meme Coin Dinner Exposes a 94% Collapse in Holder Commitments
summary: Key takeaways Wallets on the official $TRUMP dinner leaderboard held about $9.1 million at the November 16 cutoff, against roughly $148 million for the first dinner in May 2025, a drop of close to 94% in visible dollar value. That does not mean 94% of investors withdrew cash: the token price fell sharply, and the two leaderboards are not identical in size or method. The top 10 wallets held about 81% of the tokens on the public board, and the top 29 about 95%. Public Citizen traced 66 of the 130 displayed wallets to exchanges that restrict US customers, which is not proof about who attended. Donald Trump’s latest meme coin dinner came with a striking financial comparison: wallets displayed on the official $TRUMP dinner leaderboard held approximately $9.1 million in tokens at the November 16 cutoff, compared with roughly $148 million associated with the first dinner in May 2025. That puts the decline in the publicly measured dollar value at close to 94%. It does not mean investors withdrew 94% of their cash, or that 94% fewer people turned up for dinner. Trump hosted the third event for major $TRUMP holders at his Virginia golf club on Sunday, November 22. The gathering itself was new, but the more interesting story is what the leaderboard reveals about a token that was once able to turn a private invitation into a market-wide buying contest. NewsBTC previously covered an earlier $TRUMP meme coin dinner rally. This time, the numbers tell a considerably less flattering story about the value attached to that privilege. What the 94% Figure Actually Measures The roughly $9.1 million estimate comes from Public Citizen’s November 22 review of the 130 wallets displayed on the final public leaderboard. Its researchers counted 9,794,832.87 $TRUMP tokens and valued them at approximately $0.93 each at the November 16, 9 a.m. Eastern cutoff. The older $148 million comparison refers to the first gala’s leaderboard in May 2025. # Name Wallet Time-weighted holdings Latest $TRUMP balance Days held 1 FastX Dd54…uHDD 1,389,617.57 1,771,794.76 39.45 2 few DNLo…EoY6 1,093,044.76 1,000,000.00 35.75 3 Unitas Mhgx…itas 997,566.73 1,241,671.11 46.33 4 taotao BWgb…drJH 984,339.81 1,147,626.05 40.20 5 Yulia Gzyw…d6cp 966,503.35 1,126,182.24 40.23 6 GoTrump 3MwE…R1oS 453,211.23 459,963.62 46.34 7 FASTXCO H1fu…hh1c 436,614.04 700,002.00 29.24 8 ymca 8TUd…kg3S 137,348.63 140,000.96 45.98 9 3Eye 8DHk…qRjW 117,063.01 200,000.00 27.43 10 cl16 FNUY…Mts9 118,840.61 122,552.25 45.45 Source: Official $TRUMP Gala Dinner Leaderboard (November 16, 2026). Rankings based on time-weighted token holdings. Wallet entries do not necessarily represent individual attendees. That works out to a decline of roughly 93.9%, rounded to 94%. But the events did not have identical leaderboard sizes or necessarily identical valuation methods. More importantly, the token’s price fell dramatically between the two events. A lower marked-to-market balance can reflect falling prices even if some holders retain comparable token quantities. Calling this a 94% collapse in new investment would therefore be wrong. The narrower conclusion is still hard to ignore: the value represented by the public competition for dinner access is a small fraction of what it was at the first event. The leaderboard also should not be mistaken for a headcount. While the public display showed 130 wallets, organizers said 185 wallets qualified under the event’s rules. One person can control multiple wallets, and a wallet can be held for an organization. Neither figure identifies exactly who attended Sunday night’s dinner. A Few Wallets Still Control Most of the Leaderboard The smaller overall value is only part of the picture. Public Citizen found that the top 10 wallets held about 81% of the tokens on the public board. The top 29 accounted for approximately 95%. Those top-ranked wallets were also eligible for a special VIP reception. The concentration matters because a leaderboard is marketed as a contest between investors, but its aggregate value can be dominated by a very small number of positions. Looking at the $9.1 million as if it represented broad, evenly distributed enthusiasm would be as misleading as treating all 130 wallet entries as separate people. There is a revealing detail near the bottom of Public Citizen’s review: the wallet ranked No. 130 held only 9.71 $TRUMP, worth about $9 at the snapshot. It qualified because the competition measured time-weighted holdings over the scoring period, rather than the balance left in the wallet at the very end. That is perfectly compatible with the rules. It also shows why a dinner ranking cannot be read as a simple list of fresh purchases or long-term conviction. There is another market point here. A buyer who wants dinner access can acquire the token and hedge some of the price risk elsewhere. Holding a spot position long enough to earn a place does not necessarily make someone a directional believer in the coin. In that sense, the competition measures an incentive to qualify, not a clean vote of confidence in future returns. The Wallet Trail Raises Questions, Not Conclusions About Guests Public Citizen’s researchers traced 66 of the 130 displayed wallets, or 51%, to direct transfers from exchanges that restrict US customers. Those wallets represented about 4.35 million $TRUMP, roughly 44% of the public board’s token holdings. Among the top 29 VIP-ranked wallets, 15 had received tokens directly from such exchanges, according to the group’s November 22 findings. That is useful on-chain information. It is not proof that 66 dinner guests were foreign nationals, that all those exchanges served prohibited customers, or that any particular attendee broke a rule. An exchange withdrawal identifies a source of tokens, not a passport or the identity of the person controlling the receiving wallet. Public Citizen put a basic transparency problem plainly: “The names of the invitees have not been disclosed.” That sentence matters because a wallet address, however transparent its transaction history, cannot supply the accountability that a named guest list would provide. The event’s official website states: “ GetTrumpMemes.com is not political and has nothing to do with any political campaign or any political office or governmental agency. GetTrumpMemes.com · Official website That is the organizers’ characterization. It does not remove the transparency question created when holders of a president-linked digital asset can compete for personal access to the president. Neither does that question, by itself, prove an improper exchange of favors. The Dinner Still Has Value. The Token’s Investment Case Is Another Matter. There is a credible bullish counterargument. An exclusive dinner is a limited, experience driven reward. Its value to attendees need not move in lockstep with the coin’s market capitalization, and falling token prices can make it cheaper for new participants to qualify. The gala went ahead, and its promoters continue to offer other experiences to holders. But that is precisely why we should be careful about treating an invitation contest as evidence of a durable investment base. Access is an incentive. It is not a claim on business earnings, and it does not put a floor under the price of the coin. The most uncomfortable part of this comparison for $TRUMP holders is not that the dinner was smaller or less glamorous. The available figures do not establish either claim. It is that the token’s most recognizable promotional feature remains personal access, while the dollar value visible on the public leaderboard has fallen dramatically since the first event. In our view, that weakens the argument that repeated celebrity events, by themselves, can sustain the market’s appetite for the token. A more persuasive sign of recovering demand would be durable, independently observable holdings beyond a contest period, with less dependence on a few top-ranked wallets. The next useful data would be post-event wallet balances and exchange flows, measured against the November 16 snapshot, not just another photograph from the dinner. For now, the 94% comparison is a warning about the dollar value of the visible leaderboard, not proof of a 94% investor exodus. That distinction makes the story more credible, and no less troubling for anyone relying on the dinner promotion as an investment thesis. title: Fusionist ACE Bridge Exploit: $5.7M Loss Estimate, Bithumb Freezes Trading
summary: Key takeaways The Fusionist ACE bridge exploit is estimated at $5.7 million across two stages, according to SlowMist, which is not an audited final total. About $1.87 million in proceeds was traced to the attacker, while 53.7 million genuine ACE tokens, valued near $3.7 million, were reportedly withdrawn through the bridge. Bithumb halted ACE trading on November 23 after finding signs that abnormally issued ACE had entered exchanges. In the material reviewed, Fusionist has not published a reconciled loss figure or a technical post-mortem. The Fusionist ACE bridge exploit has produced an estimated $5.7 million in losses across two stages, according to SlowMist’s incident tracker. After unbacked ACE tokens were minted on BNB Chain and sold, traders reportedly used the resulting price collapse to withdraw real ACE from the project’s Endurance bridge reserves. The fallout reached centralized exchanges on Monday, November 23: Bithumb halted ACE trading after finding indications that abnormally issued tokens had entered crypto exchanges. This was not one attacker walking away with $5.7 million in a single transaction. The distinction matters. Roughly $1.87 million was traced through the attacker’s proceeds, while another 53.7 million genuine ACE tokens, valued around $3.7 million at the incident’s reference prices, were reportedly withdrawn through the bridge. SlowMist lists a combined $5.7 million loss estimate, not an audited final total. The bridge’s most basic promise, that a token issued on one chain corresponds to something real on another, is precisely what now needs proving. A Privileged Minter Printed Tokens That Had No Backing Security firm Blockaid flagged the Fusionist bridge-minter exploit on November 22. Its alert described the mechanism bluntly: “ A privileged token-bridge minter minted unbacked ACE and sold it for USDT. Blockaid · November 22 alert The firm initially estimated that about $1.04 million had been extracted while the attack was still ongoing. That was an interim snapshot, not a cap on the damage. Blockchain-monitoring account Onchain Lens subsequently reported that an attacker had routed 1,091.5 ETH, valued at about $1.87 million at the time, through Tornado Cash. That observation traces a movement of proceeds, not an extra $1.87 million to add on top of the initial extraction estimate. The values describe different points in the same suspected attacker’s fund flow. Fusionist acknowledged an apparent ongoing ACE exploit on BNB Smart Chain on Sunday and asked users to suspend transfers, trading and bridging on that network. It has not, in the material reviewed, provided a reconciled loss figure or a technical post-mortem identifying how the privileged minting authority was abused. A bridge minter is supposed to create a token representation only when the corresponding value is properly accounted for. Once the right to mint is misused, a chain can show perfectly ordinary-looking balances that have no matching backing. It is a familiar failure mode: NewsBTC previously covered a bridge-role exploit that minted unbacked tokens at CrediX. That earlier case does not establish Fusionist’s root cause, but it illustrates why elevated bridge permissions are such a consequential security boundary. Traders Found a Second Exit Through Real ACE Reserves The subsequent drain may prove more important than the initial minting spree. According to SlowMist’s November 22 incident entry, traders bought the sharply discounted ACE created by the market disruption and used the cross-chain bridge to withdraw about 53.7 million genuine ACE from the Endurance-side reserves. SlowMist valued that withdrawal at approximately $3.7 million. Here is the mechanism without the jargon. A representation of ACE on BNB Chain suddenly became cheap because unauthorized supply had flooded the market. A bridge that would still accept those tokens in exchange for ACE on Endurance offered an obvious difference in value. Anyone able to complete that conversion could receive real tokens in return for deeply discounted ones. The trading opportunity existed because the backing and the circulating representation were no longer in a trustworthy relationship. The $3.7 million figure is a valuation of the ACE reserve outflow, not proof that every recipient sold those tokens for $3.7 million in cash. Nor does it mean every trader involved helped compromise the minter. There is a meaningful difference between initiating the security breach and trading through a system whose defenses have already failed. Those distinctions should not obscure the core problem. A bridge can have technically valid transactions and still produce an economically disastrous result. If unbacked supply can be redeemed for genuine reserves, the checks have failed where they matter most. Bithumb’s Monday Halt Shows How Far the Problem Travelled Bithumb suspended ACE deposits and withdrawals early on November 23. It then halted trading effective 7:30 a.m. Korea time, according to its follow-up ACE security notice. The exchange said, in a translation from its Korean announcement, that it had: “ confirmed indications that abnormally issued ACE had entered cryptocurrency exchanges. Bithumb · ACE security notice It identified two related BNB Chain transactions and a second transaction. Those records are important evidence leads, but a full independent decoding of the transaction trail remains outstanding. Bithumb’s wording is careful: it reported signs of abnormal supply entering exchanges, not a finding that every ACE token in customer accounts is invalid. The trading suspension is a protective response, not a finalized determination of customer losses. Still, it creates a practical problem for holders who never used the bridge. If tokens are fungible within a market, exchanges and the issuer need a credible method for identifying affected supply and deciding how deposits, balances and trades will be treated. The Real Security Question Is Why the Bridge Could Honor the Claims There is an understandable temptation to focus on the enormous minting figures. The more consequential question is what happened when those tokens met the bridge’s reserves. A system does not need to lose control of its entire blockchain to suffer a serious failure in one privileged contract role. Nor should a successful-looking bridge transaction count as evidence that the asset being transferred was fully backed. Our assessment The response cannot end with a pause notice and a promise to investigate. Fusionist needs to show which minting permissions were affected, whether they have been revoked, how much ACE was created without backing, how the Endurance-side reserve changed and what claims remain outstanding. Exchanges need a defensible token-treatment plan, and holders need to know whether there is a shortfall and who is responsible for covering it. There is a fair counterargument: the $5.7 million figure is an external estimate, market prices moved during the incident, and the precise compromise method is not established. SlowMist categorizes the incident as private-key leakage, but that classification is not a substitute for an official technical finding. It would also be premature to treat a cautious exchange halt as proof that every affected customer suffered a loss. Those qualifications change how the numbers should be reported. They do not make the underlying bridge-accounting failure less serious. The next credible milestone is not a restored interface or a reassuring social post. It is a transparent reconciliation of the tokens minted, the reserves withdrawn and the assets still available to back legitimate ACE claims. Until that exists, the estimated $5.7 million fallout remains a warning about both token security and the risks of trusting a bridge’s accounting. title: HTX Research Publishes Six-Month Outlook for Bitcoin and Crypto Markets
summary: Apia, Samoa, November 20, 2026 – HTX Research, the dedicated research arm of HTX, has published a new report titled From a Price Rebound to a Recovery in Capital Flows: A Six-Month Outlook for Bitcoin and Crypto Markets. The report addresses a central question for the months ahead: after a significant amount of leverage has been liquidated, who has the capital to absorb the remaining selling pressure? Its base case is that selling pressure will ease and BTC will attempt to stabilize first, with the durability of any recovery depending on whether sustained inflows return. The report covers the current cycle position, macroeconomic and dollar liquidity constraints, ETF and digital asset treasury company flows, stablecoin market dynamics, on-chain cost ranges, derivatives and spot liquidity, and the divergence across crypto assets. It also sets out the key observation windows from late November 2026 through May 2027, along with conditional scenarios for the six-month period. The full report is available at: https://square.htx.com/htx-research-latest-report-from-a-price-rebound-to-a-recovery-in-capital-flows-a-six-month-outlook-for-bitcoin-and-crypto-markets/ About HTX Research HTX Research is the dedicated research arm of HTX Group, responsible for conducting in-depth analyses, producing comprehensive reports, and delivering expert evaluations across a broad spectrum of topics, including cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, and emerging market trends. title: Banks Are Adopting Stablecoins: Here Is Why Crypto-Native Dollars Still Win on User Freedom
summary: As traditional giants rush into digital dollars, USDD’s Yvonne Chia explains why 24/7 access, self-custody, and transparent yield give decentralized stablecoins an edge banks can’t replicate. 20 November – Road Town, Totorla, British Virgin Islands – Decentralized stablecoin protocol USDD is accelerating its multichain utility across TRON, Ethereum, and BNB Chain—combining automated sUSDD yield via its Smart Allocator with GasFree zero-TRX transfers—as traditional financial giants race to build competing stablecoin rails. In a recent industry interview with instant exchange partner ChangeNOW, USDD Head of Communications Yvonne Chia outlined why self-custody, 24/7 settlement, and transparent onchain reserves give decentralized digital dollars a structural advantage over bank-issued alternatives. 1. Permissionless Access vs. Gatekept Accounts For billions of people globally, opening and maintaining a traditional bank account still involves paperwork, minimum balance requirements, geographic restrictions, and approval delays. Even when banks integrate stablecoin rails behind the scenes, those services remain gated behind legacy compliance walls and intermediary control. Crypto-native stablecoins flip that model on its head. As Yvonne Chia highlighted during the interview: “Compare this to a stablecoin like USDD, where all you need is a phone, a working internet connection, you can immediately start a wallet and you have access to your funds right away.” With USDD, users can access and manage their digital dollars directly through their own wallets, without depending on traditional financial intermediaries. This represents a fundamental shift in financial access: users are no longer limited to the services, operating hours, or account structures of a single institution. Instead, they have the freedom to hold, manage, and transfer their assets on their own terms. Self-custody also gives users greater autonomy over their financial decisions. They can choose which wallets to use, where to transfer their assets, and which supported decentralized applications to interact with, without needing to route every transaction through a centralized financial institution. With USDD, users’ digital dollars can move with them across an open blockchain ecosystem, rather than remaining tied to a particular bank or service provider. 2. 24/7 Global Settlement vs. “Banking Hours” Legacy payment networks still operate on decades-old schedules: weekend cutoffs, bank holidays, and multi-day cross-border settlement delays accompanied by hefty wire fees. Blockchain networks never close. Whether it is a Sunday night or a public holiday, USDD moves globally without depending on traditional banking operating hours or settlement windows. “We are able to have transfers 24/7 and we’re not limited to any traditional banking hours. So I think that in some ways, stablecoins are not just becoming banks, but exceeding what traditional banks can offer to users.” To make everyday transfers even smoother than fintech apps, USDD introduced GasFree integration on TRON, allowing users on supported wallets to pay network fees directly in USDD without needing to hold TRX. This removes another practical barrier to stablecoin adoption: having to acquire and maintain a separate gas token just to transfer digital dollars. With GasFree, eligible users can pay approximately 0.5 USDD per transaction, compared with around 1.5 USDT for a standard USDT transfer under the referenced fee conditions. These improvements matter because the usefulness of a stablecoin is not determined by its peg alone. Low-cost transfers, straightforward wallet experiences, and around-the-clock availability are what make digital dollars practical for everyday payments and global value transfers. 3. Passing Yield Back to Users vs. Bank Spreads Perhaps the sharpest contrast between banks and decentralized stablecoins lies in how yield is distributed. In traditional banking, institutions take customer deposits, deploy them into yield-generating markets, and retain a significant portion of the returns. Everyday depositors may receive relatively low interest rates, while higher-yielding products often come with eligibility requirements, minimum deposits, or fixed maturity periods. Stablecoins introduce another way to participate in digital-dollar opportunities. Rather than keeping capital entirely within a traditional deposit account, users can access onchain yield opportunities through decentralized protocols and transparent investment mechanisms. USDD was built to return that value directly to holders. Through USDD Earn, users can deposit USDD to receive sUSDD, earning automated, competitive yield powered by our Smart Allocator system, with no fixed lock-up periods restricting access to their capital. For users, the distinction is important: USDD Earn provides access to a productive stablecoin while maintaining flexibility, rather than requiring users to commit their capital to a conventional fixed-term product. 4. Onchain Verification vs. Institutional Trust Traditional banks ask customers to trust closed-door balance sheets and periodic regulatory filings—until a crisis proves otherwise. USDD takes a different approach through its “Don’t trust, verify” ethos, emphasizing publicly accessible onchain information and independent verification. Onchain Transparency: Smart contract addresses, collateral reserves, and Smart Allocator deployments are publicly viewable, allowing users to examine relevant information directly on the blockchain. Structured Disclosures: Quarterly Treasury Reports provide additional information about reserve positions, financial performance, and operational developments. Independent Security Reviews: USDD undergoes third-party security audits to assess its smart contracts and identify potential vulnerabilities. Transparency does not eliminate financial or technical risks, but it changes how users can evaluate them. Instead of relying exclusively on an institution’s assurances, users have access to information that can be independently examined and verified. 5. Beyond a Single Network: An Open, Multichain Financial Ecosystem Financial freedom is not just about holding digital dollars. It is also about being able to use them wherever opportunities and applications exist. A stablecoin confined to a single network or limited use case cannot fully realize the potential of open blockchain finance. Following its January 2025 protocol upgrade, USDD expanded natively from TRON onto Ethereum and BNB Chain, extending its reach across multiple blockchain ecosystems. This multichain presence allows USDD to connect with different communities, liquidity environments, and decentralized applications. Its sUSDD product has also expanded into DeFi integrations, including Pendle and Morpho, giving users additional ways to access yield strategies across supported ecosystems. The bigger picture is an interconnected financial ecosystem in which users can move between holding, transferring, exchanging, and deploying their stablecoins according to their own needs. These are not isolated functions. Together, they make stablecoins more useful as everyday financial infrastructure. The Future: Interconnected, Open, and Multichain Banks will undoubtedly continue using stablecoin rails to modernize their back-end settlement. However, true financial freedom comes from open networks where assets flow freely across protocols without intermediaries. For USDD, the opportunity goes beyond offering a dollar-pegged asset. It is about making digital dollars accessible, transferable, and productive across an interconnected financial ecosystem. From self-custody and 24/7 transfers to flexible yield opportunities and multichain DeFi access, these capabilities give users more ways to put their money to work. Banks may be bringing stablecoins into traditional finance. Crypto-native protocols are showing what stablecoins can make possible beyond it. Watch the full interview at https://x.com/USDDecentralize/status/2121126175099773054. Explore the USDD ecosystem at usdd.io. Decentralized USD (USDD) pr@usdd.io

title: BingX Adds Anthropic Spot and Perpetual Futures Trading Following Nasdaq Debut
summary: PANAMA CITY, November 19, 2026 – BingX, the world’s leading multi-asset trading platform, today announced that Anthropic (Nasdaq: ANT) is available for trading on its platform following the company’s highly anticipated initial public offering. Eligible users can trade ANT/USDT on BingX Spot or take long and short positions through USDT-margined ANTUS(ANTHROPIC) Perpetual Futures. The launch extends BingX’s Anthropic trading offering from pre-IPO exposure to markets linked to its publicly listed stock. Anthropic’s public listing marks a major milestone for the developer of Claude and brings one of the world’s most closely watched AI companies to public markets. The company set an initial offering price range of $70 to $78 per share, implying a fully diluted valuation of up to approximately $1.4 trillion. With ANT, BingX further expands its multi-asset offering, which includes more than 700 TradFi instruments through its perpetual futures markets, spanning stocks, indices, and commodities. ANTUS(ANTHROPIC) Perpetual Futures are available for trading 24/7, while ANT/USDT joins BingX’s U.S. stock spot offering of more than 7,000 listings, with 24/5 trading and a minimum purchase of $5. Users can access these markets alongside cryptocurrencies through a single BingX account, without needing to open a separate brokerage account. BingX introduced Anthropic pre-IPO perpetual futures on May 25, giving eligible users a way to trade changes in its implied valuation before the public listing. The offering was part of BingX’s broader pre-IPO trading lineup, which has also featured companies such as SpaceX and OpenAI. “An IPO changes where a company trades, but our users’ interest often starts well before listing day,” said Kevin Lee, Chief Strategy Officer of BingX. “With Anthropic, users could trade changes in its implied valuation ahead of the IPO. Now they can trade alongside stocks, commodities, currencies and crypto through the same BingX account. Connecting opportunities across markets and across different stages of a company’s journey is an important part of how we’re building the BingX multi-asset ecosystem.” To mark the launch, BingX is introducing the Anthropic IPO Trading Contest, offering eligible participants the opportunity to compete for a total of up to 150,000 USDT in individual rewards. Rankings will be determined by eligible contract trading volume, giving participants an additional opportunity to engage with the newly listed asset. About BingX Founded in 2018, BingX is the world’s leading multi-asset trading platform, serving more than 40 million users worldwide. From crypto to traditional markets, BingX connects users with a broad range of assets and opportunities across global markets through one unified platform. With perpetual futures, TradFi offerings, spot trading and copy trading, alongside AI-powered innovations, BingX delivers a reliable, intelligent, and responsive trading experience designed to help traders navigate evolving markets and act on opportunities with greater confidence and efficiency. BingX has been the Principal Partner of Chelsea FC since 2024 and became the Official Team Partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP in 2026. For media inquiries, please contact: media@bingx.com For more information, please visit: https://bingx.com/

title: Pulsar Enables USDT Deposits on TRON, Expanding Access to Everyday Stablecoin Payments
summary: Geneva, Switzerland, November 19, 2026 — Pulsar Money today announced support for USDT deposits on the TRON network, allowing users to fund their Pulsar accounts with USDT (TRC-20) and access everyday payment features through the app. With this integration, users can deposit USDT on TRON and use their balances for online purchases, subscriptions, and other everyday expenses through the Pulsar virtual card. Pulsar charges no fees for supported stablecoin deposits across its plans, although network and third-party fees may apply. The integration connects TRON’s widely adopted stablecoin infrastructure with Pulsar’s consumer-focused payment platform. In Q3 2026, TRON processed $2.21 trillion in stablecoin settlement volume, averaging $24 billion daily. By supporting USDT deposits on TRON, Pulsar offers users a convenient way to put their existing stablecoin holdings to use for everyday payments. “Supporting USDT on TRON gives people another way to bring the stablecoins they already use into Pulsar,” said Alex, Founder and CEO of Pulsar Money. “Our focus is on making those balances useful in everyday life, whether people are managing their money, shopping online, or paying for subscriptions.” “TRON’s extensive stablecoin activity reflects the growing demand for accessible, efficient digital payments,” said Sam Elfarra, Community Spokesperson for TRON DAO. “Pulsar’s integration brings that infrastructure closer to everyday use, expanding how people can access and spend their stablecoins.” Pulsar combines stablecoin balance management and payment features in a single app. To deposit USDT on TRON, users can select the supported asset and network in the Pulsar app and follow the deposit instructions. Users should ensure they select TRON (TRC-20) and send only USDT to the deposit address provided for that network. Features and availability may vary by region and service provider. About Pulsar Money Pulsar Money is a money app that brings stablecoins and everyday payment features together. Users can manage supported balances and access services including a virtual card and currency conversion, subject to availability and provider terms. Pulsar is not a bank. title: OmenX announces $2 million in funding from Informed Ventures and launches on-demand 30-second Bitcoin predictions
summary: The Base-native leveraged prediction market platform expands its offering across crypto, global financial assets, sports and esports. Toronto, November 19, 2026 – OmenX, a Base-native leveraged prediction market platform, today announced $2 million in funding from Informed Ventures alongside the launch of its on-demand, 30-second Bitcoin price prediction product. The new product lets users predict whether Bitcoin’s price will rise or fall over the next 30 seconds, with each trade starting its own prediction window. A position opened at 10:00:12 runs until 10:00:42. Users can act when their view forms, with a full 30-second horizon, rather than adapting to the remaining time in a shared market round. Featuring zero-slippage execution and rapid settlement, the product extends the familiar five- and fifteen-minute crypto prediction format to a shorter, individually timed experience. It adds to OmenX’s intraday offering, which spans prediction horizons from 30 seconds to 24 hours, depending on the market. Beyond crypto, OmenX offers directional prediction markets linked to more than 100 global assets, including U.S. equities, futures, ETFs and indices. Its event markets also cover live sports and esports, with sports coverage spanning major football leagues, basketball, American football, ice hockey, baseball and UFC. Leverage has been central to OmenX’s platform from the outset, allowing traders to amplify their exposure on supported event markets. The latest launch builds on that foundation while advancing a broader goal: making prediction markets a practical financial tool for retail users. OmenX organizes the trading decision around a defined question: will an asset’s price be higher or lower at the end of a specified period? Users can express a directional view without purchasing the underlying asset, targeting an exact closing price or constructing an options position that requires decisions about strikes, implied volatility and time decay. “Leverage has been part of OmenX from the start, but our ambition goes beyond adding leverage to prediction markets,” said James, founder and CEO of OmenX. “We want to make global markets easier to participate in. A trader should be able to take a view on Bitcoin, a stock or a sporting event and express it through a clear contract and a timeframe that fits their judgment.” The platform’s emphasis on short, recurring markets provides faster feedback on trading decisions and can reduce the time capital remains committed to individual outcomes. OmenX plans to expand its coverage of traditional and crypto assets while deepening the trading experience across supported markets. About OmenX OmenX is a Base-native leveraged prediction market platform covering crypto, global financial assets, live sports and esports. Through defined outcomes, short settlement cycles and leverage on supported markets, OmenX is building a more accessible way to trade market views. Learn more at omenx.com. Media contact James Zhang Founder at OmenX james@omenx.com

title: MEXC’s Hacken-Audited November 2026 Proof of Reserves Shows Reserve Ratios Above 100% Across Major Assets
summary: Mutsamudu, Comoros, November 19, 2026 – MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, has released its November 2026 Proof of Reserves (PoR) report, independently audited by Hacken. The report shows MEXC’s solid reserve position, with user assets in every major asset backed by reserves above 1:1, demonstrating MEXC’s ongoing commitment to safeguarding user assets. Spanning Proof of Liabilities, Proof of Ownership, Reserves Calculation, and Merkle Tree verification, Hacken’s November 2026 audit confirms substantial over-collateralisation across core holdings, standing at 318% for BTC, 122% for USDT, 112% for ETH, and 110% for USDC. Guided by its user-first philosophy, MEXC continues to enhance transparency to protect user assets and build trust. Since introducing Proof of Reserves in February 2023, MEXC has kept its wallet addresses and reserve data public, and its Merkle Tree system lets users verify at any time that their balances are included, without exposing other users’ data. Reserves provide an extra layer of user protection. MEXC also manages user assets across cold and hot wallets under multi-signature authorization and layered risk controls, and maintains two dedicated funds. The Guardian Fund is set aside for major security events such as exploits and targeted attacks. It holds both USDT and BTC, with BTC added in May and September this year, with plans to reach $500 million within two years. The Futures Insurance Fund absorbs losses exceeding a user’s margin following liquidation, acting as a vital capital buffer during extreme market volatility. To ensure full transparency across MEXC’s risk-protection framework, wallet addresses for the broader Guardian Fund are publicly disclosed, while real-time and historical balances for each trading pair remain accessible via the Insurance Fund Account page. To view the latest Proof of Reserves snapshot and audit report, please visit the MEXC Proof of Reserves page. Serving users across 170+ markets, MEXC provides simple and efficient access to crypto, stocks, tokenized assets, derivatives, and a growing range of TradFi-linked opportunities through one account and one gateway. With 0 trading fees, deep liquidity, broad asset coverage, and a high-performance trading experience, MEXC is designed for retail users who want to discover earlier, act faster, and trade with fewer barriers. As crypto and traditional finance continue to converge, MEXC is committed to making global opportunities more accessible, helping users trade freely and MEXCmize every opportunity. title: WSDT introduces prop trading for crypto and tokenized US stocks
summary: One-step challenges start at $19, with a free demo and weekly competitions available in the same trading terminal DUBAI, UAE, November 18, 2026 – WSDT is introducing its prop trading platform for cryptocurrency perpetual futures, gold and tokenized US stocks. Traders can access these markets through a single simulated account, with one-step evaluations starting at a one-time fee of $19 for a $1,500 account. The platform combines crypto perpetual futures, including Bitcoin and Ethereum, with xStocks instruments tracking companies such as Apple, NVIDIA and Tesla, alongside stock-index ETFs. Perpetual futures are contracts without an expiry date; xStocks track the prices of underlying shares or ETFs. On WSDT, these instruments are traded in a simulated environment, without ownership of the underlying shares or tokens. Positions across the markets share the same account balance and count toward the same evaluation. Traders can work across crypto and equity-linked instruments in one terminal while managing a single set of account limits. One evaluation, published trading rules A WSDT challenge tests trading performance against a 10% profit target, a 4% daily loss limit and a 6% maximum drawdown fixed against the starting account size. Traders must trade on at least four separate days, with no deadline to complete the evaluation. Account sizes range from $1,500 to $200,000, with fees varying by size. Traders who pass move to a funded-stage account, which is also simulated and retains the loss limits. They receive 80% of eligible profits under WSDT’s Provider Service Agreement. The evaluation fee pays for access to the challenge; it is not a trading deposit. Free ways to try the platform Registered users can open a free 14-day demo with a $100,000 simulated balance, without providing a payment card or making a deposit. The demo uses the same terminal as challenges, allowing traders to practice before entering an evaluation. Demo results do not qualify for payouts. WSDT also runs an ongoing weekly competition with free entry. Every participant starts with a $240,000 simulated balance, and the top three finishers receive challenge accounts. A new round opens each Monday at noon New York time. Winners must pass their awarded challenge before progressing to the funded stage. Registration, account options and full challenge rules are available on the WSDT website. About WSDT WSDT provides trader evaluation and educational services across crypto, gold and tokenized equity instruments. Built by TEFS, a prop trading firm established in 2017, it is operated by TEFS Marketing Management L.L.C. in Dubai, UAE. All WSDT trading accounts are simulated. Contact WSDT support@wsdt.com

title: Aave App Launches on TRON, Bringing USDT Deposits to Mobile Users on Android and iOS
summary: Geneva, Switzerland – TRON DAO, the community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet through blockchain technology and decentralized applications (dApps), today announced that the Aave App, a high-yield savings mobile app developed and managed by Aave Labs, will add support for USDT (TRC-20) deposits on the TRON network as it expands to Android following its initial launch on iOS. The launch combines Android’s global reach with TRON’s leading role in the stablecoin ecosystem, expanding mobile access to onchain savings opportunities that are not accessible on traditional savings apps. With support for USDT on TRON, eligible users in supported jurisdictions can now deposit USDT on TRON and start earning yield on their savings. Android’s extensive global footprint offers a significant distribution opportunity for digital asset applications, particularly in markets where stablecoins are used for payments, remittances, and savings. TRON provides an established infrastructure for this opportunity, with more than $94 billion in circulating USDT, the largest circulating supply of Tether’s dollar-pegged stablecoin among blockchain networks. TRON also supports a broad range of stablecoin use cases, including payments, cross-border transfers, and digital asset transactions. Aave is building the World’s Savings App, a simple, globally accessible tool designed to help people grow and manage their savings, with a delightful design experience on the surface and powerful onchain finance infrastructure working under the hood. Users of the app can earn yield on their savings, enjoy flexible access to their funds, and benefit from the Balance Protection program. They can also deposit and withdraw via stablecoins or banks in eligible countries and project their potential savings growth over the years with a future simulator. Following its availability on iOS, the Android launch expands the app’s mobile reach, while TRON support connects users to one of the largest USDT ecosystems in onchain finance. “Aave Labs has a proven track record of building leading DeFi products, and the Aave App brings that expertise to everyday users,” said Justin Sun, Founder of TRON. “With TRON support on Android and iOS, more people can use the USDT they already hold on TRON to access simple, accessible onchain savings with the Aave App.” “Millions of people in emerging economies already rely on stablecoins on TRON to save and send money,” said Stani Kulechov, Founder and CEO of Aave Labs. “The Aave App lets them earn on those dollars.” By enabling USDT deposits through the Aave App on Android, the integration connects TRON’s established stablecoin ecosystem with a consumer-focused mobile application. The launch reflects the continued convergence of mobile applications and blockchain infrastructure, as consumer-focused products work to make digital assets and decentralized financial services more accessible worldwide. About TRON DAO TRON DAO is a community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet via blockchain technology and dApps. Founded in September 2017, the TRON blockchain has experienced significant growth since its MainNet launch in May 2018. Today, TRON hosts the largest circulating supply of USD Tether (USDT) stablecoin, which currently exceeds $94 billion. As of November 2026, the TRON blockchain has recorded over 414 million in total user accounts, more than 16 billion in total transactions, and over $24 billion in total value locked (TVL), based on TRONSCAN. Recognized as the global settlement layer for stablecoin transactions and everyday purchases with proven success, TRON is “Moving Trillions, Empowering Billions.” TRONNetwork | TRONDAO | X | YouTube | Telegram | Discord | Reddit | GitHub | Medium | Forum About Aave Labs Aave Labs is a core contributor in the Aave network and builds products that make saving, lending and borrowing simple and accessible worldwide. Aave is the world’s largest onchain lending network, with more than $30 billion in net deposits. Users, fintechs and financial institutions use it to earn interest on stablecoins and other assets and to borrow against them, 24/7, with every transaction visible onchain. The network is governed by the Aave DAO, where AAVE holders vote on changes to the network and its treasury. Aave Labs’ products include Aave App, a savings app for everyone; Aave Pro, for advanced lending and borrowing; Aave Kit, which lets fintechs and businesses offer savings and loans to their users; and Aave Horizon, an institutional platform for borrowing stablecoins against tokenized real-world assets. For more information, visit aave.com.
